en.title: Star Trek Gets Darker: Ro Laren Returns in New Action-Adventure Game
en.summary: IGN Live 2026 has unveiled a surprising new direction for the Star Trek universe with Star Trek: Shadow Frontier. The mature, story-driven title promises a darker, more action-oriented experience than fans are accustomed to.
en.body:
IGN Live 2026, the annual celebration of all things gaming, has kicked off with a bang, and among the biggest surprises is the announcement of **Star Trek: Shadow Frontier**. This upcoming title is charting a course for a decidedly darker and more mature take on the beloved franchise, moving away from the exploration-heavy, optimistic tone often associated with Starfleet.

The game is described as a story-driven action-adventure, and its reveal trailer hinted at a narrative that delves into the grittier aspects of the Star Trek universe. Central to this new direction is the return of a fan-favorite character: former Lieutenant **Ro Laren**. Michelle Forbes, who famously portrayed Ro Laren in **Star Trek: The Next Generation**, is reprising her role and lending her voice to the character, a move that is sure to excite long-time fans.

This isn't the first time a Star Trek game has explored more mature themes, but the focus on **Ro Laren**, a character known for her rebellious nature and complex moral compass, suggests a deep dive into character-driven conflict and morally gray areas. Details about the specific gameplay mechanics and the full scope of the story remain under wraps, but the emphasis on action and narrative suggests a departure from the more strategic or simulation-focused titles that have sometimes represented the franchise.

## Control Resonant Shifts Gears

Beyond the stars, the event also provided an update on **Control Resonant**, the highly anticipated sequel to Remedy Entertainment's critically acclaimed supernatural shooter. Creative Director Mikael Kasurinen was on hand to discuss the game's evolution, revealing a significant shift in its core design. The team has opted to move **Control Resonant** towards a more action-RPG focused experience. This pivot suggests a deeper emphasis on character progression, loot systems, and potentially more expansive combat mechanics, aiming to build upon the unique world and powers established in the original game while offering a fresh gameplay loop.

## What This Means for Gamers

The announcement of **Star Trek: Shadow Frontier** and the design shift for **Control Resonant** signal a willingness from major publishers and developers to experiment with established IPs and cater to a more discerning audience. For Star Trek fans, the prospect of a darker, character-focused narrative starring **Ro Laren** offers a compelling new way to engage with the universe. Meanwhile, the move towards an action-RPG for **Control Resonant** promises a deeper, more replayable experience for fans of the original, potentially attracting a wider audience within the action-RPG community.

## What's Next

IGN Live 2026 continues throughout the weekend, with further reveals and updates expected. Fans can look forward to segments featuring **My Adventures with Superman**, **Adventure Time: Side Quests**, and a deep dive into **Magic: The Gathering**.

tr.title: Star Trek Karanlık Bir Yöne Gidiyor: Ro Laren Yeni Aksiyon-Macera Oyununda Geri Dönüyor
tr.summary: IGN Live 2026, Star Trek evrenine yeni bir yön veren Star Trek: Shadow Frontier'i tanıttı. Bu olgun, hikaye odaklı oyun, hayranların alışık olduğu deneyimden daha karanlık ve aksiyon dolu bir deneyim vaat ediyor. former Lieutenant Ro Laren'in geri dönüşü, uzun süredir beklenen bir gelişme.
tr.body:
IGN Live 2026, her şeyin oyun olduğu yıllık kutlaması, büyük bir sürprizle başladı ve en büyük sürprizlerden biri de Star Trek: Shadow Frontier'in duyurusuydu. Bu yeni oyun, sevgili franchise'a daha karanlık ve olgun bir yaklaşım getiriyor ve Starfleet'in thường olarak ilişkilendirildiği keşif odaklı, iyimser tondan uzaklaşıyor.

 Oyun, hikaye odaklı bir aksiyon-macera olarak tanımlanıyor ve tanıtımları, Star Trek evreninin daha çetrefilli yönlerine değinen bir anlatıya işaret ediyor. Bu yeni yönelimin merkezinde, bir fan-favori karakterin dönüşü yer alıyor: eski Teğmen Ro Laren. Michelle Forbes, Star Trek: The Next Generation'da Ro Laren'i ünlü bir şekilde canlandırdı ve karaktere sesini verdi, bu da uzun süredir hayranların heyecanlanacağı bir hamle.

 ## Kontrol Noktası Değişimi

 Etkinlik ayrıca, highly anticipated Control Resonant'in gelişimine ilişkin bir güncelleme sağladı. Yaratıcı Direktör Mikael Kasurinen, oyunun evrimini tartışmak için orada bulundu ve core tasarımında önemli bir değişikliği açıkladı. Takım, Control Resonant'i daha çok aksiyon-RPG odaklı bir deneyime doğru yöneltti. Bu değişim, karakter ilerlemesi, hazine sistemleri ve daha geniş savaş mekanikleri üzerinde daha derin bir vurguyu öneriyor ve benzersiz bir dünya ve güçler kurarken taze bir oyun döngüsü sunmayı amaçlıyor.

 ## Bu, Oyuncular İçin Ne Anlama Geliyor

 Star Trek: Shadow Frontier'in duyurusu ve Control Resonant'in tasarım değişikliği, büyük yayıncılar ve geliştiricilerin kurulan IP'lerle deneysel yaklaşmaya ve daha seçici bir kitleye hitap etmeye istekli olduğunu gösteriyor. Star Trek hayranları için, Ro Laren'in başrolde olduğu daha karanlık, karakter odaklı bir anlatının perspektifi, evrenle etkileşim kurmak için yeni bir yol sunuyor. Bu arada, Control Resonant için aksiyon-RPG'ye doğru kayma, orijinalin benzersiz dünyası ve güçleri üzerinde daha derin, daha tekrar oynanabilir bir deneyim vaat ediyor ve potentially daha geniş bir kitleye hitap edecek.

 ## Sonraki Adımlar

 IGN Live 2026 hafta sonu boyunca devam edecek ve daha fazla açıklama ve güncelleme bekleniyor. Hayranlar, My Adventures with Superman, Adventure Time: Side Quests ve Magic: The Gathering hakkında derinlemesine bir inceleme bekleyebilir.

es.title: Star Trek: El Frente de la Sombra: Ro Laren vuelve con un nuevo juego de acción y aventuras
es.summary: IGN Live 2026 ha desvelado una nueva dirección sorprendente para el universo de Star Trek con Star Trek: Shadow Frontier. Este título promete una experiencia más oscura y centrada en la historia que los fanáticos están acostumbrados a ver.
es.body:
IGN Live 2026, la celebración anual de todo lo relacionado con los juegos, ha comenzado con un gran impacto, y entre las sorpresas más grandes está la anuncio del título **Star Trek: Shadow Frontier**. Este juego en desarrollo está trazando un curso hacia una visión más oscura y madura del universo amado, alejándose de la exploración pesada y el tono optimista a menudo asociado con la Flota Estelar.

Este juego es descrito como una aventura de acción y historia, y su trailer de revelación sugirió una narrativa que se adentra en los aspectos más oscuros del universo de Star Trek. Al centro de esta nueva dirección está el regreso de un personaje favorito de los fanáticos: la ex Teniente **Ro Laren**. Michelle Forbes, quien famosamente interpretó a Ro Laren en **Star Trek: The Next Generation**, está reprendiendo su papel y prestando su voz a la característica, lo que sin duda emocionará a los fanáticos de larga data.

No es la primera vez que un juego de Star Trek explora temas más maduros, pero el enfoque en **Ro Laren**, una característica conocida por su naturaleza rebelde y su compás moral complejo, sugiere una inmersión profunda en conflictos de personajes y áreas morales grises. Los detalles sobre los mecanismos de juego específicos y el alcance completo de la historia siguen bajo secreto, pero el énfasis en acción y narrativa sugiere un cambio en la dirección del título en comparación con los juegos estratégicos o de simulación que a veces representan la franquicia.

## Cambios en Control Resonant

Más allá de las estrellas, el evento también proporcionó una actualización sobre **Control Resonant**, el secuela altamente anticipada del shooter sobrenatural críticamente aclamado de Remedy Entertainment. El Director Creativo Mikael Kasurinen estuvo en el escenario para discutir la evolución del juego, revelando un cambio significativo en su diseño central. El equipo ha optado por mover **Control Resonant** hacia una experiencia más enfocada en RPG de acción. Este giro sugiere un énfasis más profundo en la progresión de personajes, sistemas de botín y potencialmente más amplias mecánicas de combate, con el objetivo de construir sobre el mundo único y poderes establecidos en el juego original mientras ofrece un nuevo bucle de juego.

## Lo que esto significa para los jugadores

El anuncio de **Star Trek: Shadow Frontier** y el cambio de diseño para **Control Resonant** señalan una disposición de los editores principales y desarrolladores a experimentar con IPs establecidas y satisfacer a un público más exigente. Para los fanáticos de Star Trek, la posibilidad de una narrativa más oscura y centrada en personajes protagonizada por **Ro Laren** ofrece una forma atractiva de involucrarse con el universo. Mientras tanto, el movimiento hacia un RPG de acción para **Control Resonant** promete una experiencia más profunda y replayable para los fanáticos del original, potencialmente atraer a un público más amplio dentro de la comunidad de RPG de acción.

## Próximos Pasos

IGN Live 2026 continúa durante el fin de semana, con revelaciones y actualizaciones adicionales esperadas. Los fanáticos pueden esperar segmentos que presenten **Mis Aventuras con Superman**, **Adventure Time: Side Quests** y una inmersión profunda en **Magic: The Gathering**.

content_raw: IGN Live 2026 has arrived, and we've got a two-day celebration of all things gaming and entertainment filled with celebrity panels, exclusive game reveals, trailers, live stage shows, hands-on demos, giveaways, and so much more. While we're hosting IGN Live in-person in downtown Los Angeles at Magic Box @ The Reef on June 6-7, we're also livestreaming the biggest moments! Furthermore, this guide will gather all the biggest reveals right here in this guide, and we'll keep updating it throughout the weekend! There are plenty of surprises in store, but look out for segments on Day 1 with such heavy hitters as Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced, Backyard Baseball, Control Resonant, Jackass: Best and Last, 007 First Light / Hitman, Avatar: The Last Airbender, Star Trek’s 60th anniversary celebrations, ID@Xbox, The Death of Robin Hood, and more. On Day 2, we're looking forward to featuring My Adventures with Superman, a watch party and reaction to the Xbox Games Showcase, Adventure Time: Side Quests, Magic: The Gathering, Poppy Playtime, Rick and Morty, Big Brother, Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, and more. Star Trek: Shadow Frontier Game Reveal Trailer Explores Trek's Darker Side IGN Live saw the exciting reveal of the upcoming game Star Trek: Shadow Frontier, a mature, story-driven, action-adventure game that offers a different and darker side of Star Trek than is usually the norm. As shown in the reveal trailer, the game also has a notable main character in the form of former Lieutenant Ro Laren, the popular Star Trek: The Next Generation character played by Michelle Forbes. And yes, that's Forbes voicing Ro. Control Resonant Creative Director on the Sequel Shifting to an Action RPG We were able to speak to Control Resonant creative director Mikael Kasurinen about why the sequel shifted to an action RPG. He shared that Control is all about these siblings - Jesse and Dylan Faden - and he said the idea of this change was to really spotlight how "both siblings have their own personality and approach and ways of doing things. If Jesse uses a gun, then of course Dylan uses a melee weapon." We also got a look at how Remedy built a surreal, brutalist world for Control Resonant using the latest NVIDIA tools, and you can check that out above! How Neon Genesis Evangelion Inspired Control Resonant We sit down with Control Resonant's director, Mikael Kasurinen, as he explains how Neon Genesis Evangelion served as a major inspiration for Control Resonant while he walks us through brand-new gameplay and combat mechanics of the upcoming melee-centric action sequel. The Jackass: Best and Last Crew Relive the Painful Good Times At IGN Live, things took a turn for the Jackass, as Steve-O, Wee Man (Jason Acuña), Poopies (Sean McInerney), and Jasper were on hand to prep audiences for the upcoming fifth and final film in the gang's film series, Jackass: Best and Last.
